name: Vulnerability Bolt
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 25
Aura faint necromancy CL 5th
Slot none; Price 496 gp ; Weight 1/10 lb.
Description
If poison is applied to this sickly yellow +1 bolt, any hit point damage, ability damage, or ability drain dealt by the poison increases by 1 each round for the poison’s duration.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, pernicious poisonUM; Price 251 gp
